messages:
Maya CS: Quick flag 10% of May trial orgs look duplicated in renewal-risk export. Causing noisy alerts and duplicate outreach. CSV: s3://redwood-cs/exports/may_dup_sample.csv
Luis Onboard: We keep sending onboarding emails to what is effectively the same org. Need to dedupe before playbooks fire.
Priya Data: Short analysis shows many accounts share normalized emails or null sso_id. Proposed canonicalization: lower(trim(email)), strip +aliases, fallback to company domain+org_name. SQL gist:
```sql
select lower(regexp_replace(email,'\\+.*','')) as canon, count(*) from accounts where created_at >= '2025-05-01' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 50;
```
Priya Data: Plan: add `trial_family_id` (md5(canon)) and populate nightly; change healthscore rule to count distinct trial_family_id per org. Mark siblings with `duplicate_flag=true` for CS review.
Ben Ops: We'll implement a non-blocking nightly job writing to staging and a small review UI listing siblings. Exclude flagged accounts from playbooks and renewal metrics.
Maya CS: Playbook change: replace `trial_count_org > 1` with `distinct_trial_families > 1` and a 7-day cooldown after dedupe to avoid churn.
Luis Onboard: I'll open CST ticket and a PR. Timeline: PR tomorrow, feature-flag rollout to staging midweek. Assigning @Priya Data and @Ben Ops.
DedupeBot: Scheduled job `ndj-20250724-01` for 2025-07-24T04:30:00Z :white_check_mark:
Priya Data: I'll add Grafana metric `cs.dup_trial_family_ratio` and set a warn alert at 0.05. Backfill will run over last 6 months.
Maya CS: UX ask: small opt-in checkbox on signup: "I'm joining an org already using Redwood" to help disambiguate. Wire responses into review UI.
Ben Ops: Noted. We'll also add a short note in the onboarding runbook about duplicate flags and reviewing the UI.
Luis Onboard: Thanks team 39. Will post CST id and PR when ready.
